definition: to be about to be told off
description: In a living room at dusk lit by a single floor lamp, a young man in a dark suit tiptoes across the rug in his socks, carrying his shoes in one hand. He stops and gives an awkward, guilty grin. A young woman in a cream jumper sits in an armchair with her arms crossed and a stern face, watching him, and a scruffy brown dog sits beside her chair and also stares at him. A grey sofa, framed prints and a coffee table are in the room.
